lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa benatee kare kar kirapaa dehu jee daan ||
lines.translation: The rainbird prays: O Lord, grant Your Grace, and bless me with the gift of the life of the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਊਤਰੈ ਛੁਟਕਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal bin piaas na ootarai chhutak jaa(n)hi mere praan ||
lines.translation: Without the water, my thirst is not quenched, and my breath of life is ended and gone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨੇਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: too sukhadaataa bea(n)t hai gunadaataa nedhaan ||
lines.translation: You are the Giver of peace, O Infinite Lord God; You are the Giver of the treasure of virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh bakhas lae a(n)t belee hoi bhagavaan ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is forgiven; in the end, the Lord God shall be your only friend. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape jagat upaai kai gun augan kare beechaar ||
lines.translation: He created the world; He considers the merits and demerits of the mortals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai gun sarab ja(n)jaal hai naam na dhare piaar ||
lines.translation: Those who are entangled in the three gunas - the three dispositions - do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun chhod augan kamaavade daragah hohi khuaar ||
lines.translation: Forsaking virtue, they practice evil; they shall be miserable in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jooai janam tinee haariaa kit aae sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: They lose their life in the gamble; why did they even come into the world?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad man maariaa ahinis naam piaar ||
lines.translation: But those who conquer and subdue their minds, through the True Word of the Shabad - night and day, they love the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸਚਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee purakhee ur dhaariaa sachaa alakh apaar ||
lines.translation: Those people enshrine the True, Invisible and Infinite Lord in their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਹਿ ਅਸੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: too gunadaataa nidhaan hahi asee avaganiaar ||
lines.translation: You, O Lord, are the Giver, the Treasure of virtue; I am unvirtuous and unworthy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: jis bakhase so paaisee gurasabadee veechaar ||13||
lines.translation: He alone finds You, whom You bless and forgive, and inspire to contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਨ ਵਿਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਕਤਾਂ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raat na vihaavee saakataa(n) jinhaa visarai naau ||
lines.translation: The faithless cynics forget the Name of the Lord; the night of their lives does not pass in peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤੀ ਦਿਨਸ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਂਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raatee dinas suheleeaa naanak har gun gaa(n)u ||1||
lines.translation: Their days and nights become comfortable, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕਾ ਹਭੇ ਮਣੀ ਮਥੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratan javehar maanakaa habhe manee matha(n)n ||
lines.translation: All sorts of jewels and gems, diamonds and rubies, shine forth from their foreheads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jo prabh bhaaniaa sachai dar soha(n)n ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God, look beautiful in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa satigur sev sach samhaaliaa ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, I dwell on the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਖਲੋਆ ਆਇ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t khaloaa aai j satigur agai ghaaliaa ||
lines.translation: The work you have done for the True Guru shall be very useful in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pohi na sakai jamakaal sachaa rakhavaaliaa ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death cannot even touch that person who is protected by the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur saakhee jot jagaai deevaa baaliaa ||
lines.translation: Lighting the lamp of the Guru's Teachings, my awareness has been awakened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh vin naavai kooRiaar phirahi betaaliaa ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are false; without the Name, they wander around like demons.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਮਾਣਸ ਚੰਮਿ ਪਲੇਟੇ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਕਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pasoo maanas cha(n)m palete a(n)darahu kaaliaa ||
lines.translation: They are nothing more than beasts, wrapped up in human skin; they are black-hearted within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabho varatai sach sachai sabad nihaaliaa ||
lines.translation: The True Lord is pervading all; through the True Word of the Shabad, He is seen.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam nidhaan hai poorai gur dekhaaliaa ||14||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Naam is the greatest treasure. The Perfect Guru has revealed it to me. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehai hukam pachhaaniaa gur kai sahaj subhaai ||
lines.translation: The rainbird realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command with intuitive ease through the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਘੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੂੜੀ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: megh varasai daiaa kar gooRee chhahabar laai ||
lines.translation: The clouds mercifully burst forth, and the rain pours down in torrents.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹੇ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਰਹਿ ਗਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehe kook pukaar rahi gaee sukh vasiaa man aai ||
lines.translation: The cries and wailings of the rainbird have ceased, and peace has come to abide in its mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਜੀਆ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak so saalaaheeai j de(n)daa sabhanaa(n) jeeaa rijak samaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, praise that Lord, who reaches out and gives sustenance to all beings and creatures. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤੂ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਿਖਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaatrik too na jaanahee kiaa tudh vich tikhaa hai kit peetai tikh jaai ||
lines.translation: O rainbird, you do not know what thirst is within you, or what you can drink to quench it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰੰਮਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai bhara(n)miaa a(n)mrit jal palai na paai ||
lines.translation: You wander in the love of duality, and you do not obtain the Ambrosial Water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare je aapanee taa(n) satigur milai subhaai ||
lines.translation: When God casts His Glance of Grace, then the mortal automatically meets the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur te a(n)mrit jal paaiaa sahaje rahiaa samaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Water is obtained from the True Guru, and then the mortal remains merged in the Lord with intuitive ease. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਦੁ ਨ ਦੇਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik van kha(n)d baisahi jaai sad na devahee ||
lines.translation: Some go and sit in the forest realms, and do not answer any calls.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਕਰੁ ਭੰਨਿ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਜਲੁ ਹੇਂਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik paalaa kakar bha(n)n seetal jal he(n)vahee ||
lines.translation: Some, in the dead of winter, break the ice and immerse themselves in freezing water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਭਸਮ ਚੜੑਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਧੋਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik bhasam chaRhaavahi a(n)g mail na dhovahee ||
lines.translation: Some rub ashes on their bodies, and never wash off their dirt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਜਟਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਕੁਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਖੋਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik jataa bikat bikaraal kul ghar khovahee ||
lines.translation: Some look hideous, with their uncut hair matted and dishevelled. They bring dishonor to their family and ancestry.
